mapper.select: SELECT b.category_id AS category_id, c.category_name AS category_name, SUM( CASE b.behavior_type WHEN 4 THEN 5 WHEN 5 THEN 4 WHEN 3 THEN 3 WHEN 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 + IF(b.stay_seconds >= 30, 1, 0) END ) AS score, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM ai_user_behavior b LEFT JOIN biz_resource_category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.category_id IS NOT NULL AND b.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY b.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY score DESC, behavior_count DESC, b.category_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.behavior_type = 6 AND b.source = 4 THEN 1 END) AS impressions, COUNT(CASE WHEN b.behavior_type = 1 AND b.source = 4 THEN 1 END) AS clicks, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN b.behavior_type = 6 AND b.source = 4 THEN 1 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(100 * COUNT(CASE WHEN b.behavior_type = 1 AND b.source = 4 THEN 1 END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN b.behavior_type = 6 AND b.source = 4 THEN 1 END), 1) END AS ctr FROM ai_user_behavior b WHERE b.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND b.village_id IN
#{vid}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(b.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT b.behavior_type AS type, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_user_behavior b WHERE b.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
AND b.village_id IN
#{vid}
GROUP BY b.behavior_type ORDER BY b.behavior_type ASC
